newsitem.title: USA: Culligan Water expands product offerings.
newsitem.headline: Culligan Water expands product offerings.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Monday it expanded its consumer product offerings into the mass retail channels and introduced three new consumer filtration products.
Entering the mass retail market, Culligan said, will greatly increase the number of stores that carry its products.
"Culligan currently markets its products in 5,000 outlets nationwide," Ron Rosati, Culligan group president - point of use and retail markets, said in a statement.
"With the new introductions, we expect to double the number of outlets as Culligan enters the mass retail channels," Rosati added.

Culligan said its products soon will be available in outlets such as Target, which is part of Dayton Hudson Corp; Ace Hardware ; Sam's Club, which is owned by Wal-Mart Stores Inc ; Sears, Roebuck and Co, and Federated Department Stores Inc's Bloomingdales and Macy's.

The new consumer products, introduced at the International Housewares Show in Chicago, include a designer glass pitcher filtration system and two new monitored faucet mount systems. These products will be rolled out to the high-end department store channels in the spring and summer of 1997, respectively.

"Since its inception less than one year ago, Culligan's Consumer Markets Division has continued to exceed our expectations," Douglas Pertz, Culligan president, said in a statement. "In addition, we are continuing to develop strategic relationships with major appliance manufacturers which will further strengthen Culligan's presence in the retail market place."
Culligan Water manufactures and distributes water purification and treatment products.
